integrity: Every enumerated vector is projectively normalized uniquely; both point generators and orbit/moment certificates are supplied. Finite proof does not rely on outside logs.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classifications over F_7 and F_11 only; no claim for all fields, twists, or best-known code optimality. An older numerically equivalent table remains a possible priority risk.
title: The complete rational hyperplane-section spectra of the Clebsch cubic over \(\mathbb F_7\) and \(\mathbb F_{11}\)
